method: Load only the descriptions of the six skills. Give each query to a new agent, 3 times. Record which skills the agent loads.
'expect' is the one skill of the six that must trigger, or 'none'. 'not' is the near skill that must not trigger ('all' means none of the six).
A query passes when the expected skill triggers in at least 2 of 3 tries, and the 'not' skill triggers in at most 1 of 3 tries.
A query may load other skills from outside the six. Do not count them.
